description: Abstract class 'BaseEdgeProcessor' providing core functionalities for processing edge-related events, notifications, and relations within the Thingsboard platform. Handles event saving, entity notifications, relation creation, and message pushing to rule engine.

classes.name: BaseEdgeProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing core edge processing functionalities for event handling, notifications, relations, and messaging within Thingsboard.

methods.name: saveEdgeEvent
methods.description: Saves an edge event with optional validation based on edge activity state.

methods.name: processEntityNotification
methods.description: Processes entity notifications received from edge, handling different event types and actions.

methods.name: safeGetEdgeId
methods.description: Safely constructs an EdgeId from MSB and LSB long values.

methods.name: processNotificationToRelatedEdges
methods.description: Sends notifications to all related edges for a given entity.

methods.name: updateDependentRuleChains
methods.description: Updates rule chains dependent on a specific edge.

methods.name: constructEntityId
methods.description: Constructs an EntityId based on entity type string and UUID parts.

methods.name: safeGetUUID
methods.description: Safely creates a UUID from MSB and LSB long values.

methods.name: safeGetCustomerId
methods.description: Safely creates a CustomerId from MSB and LSB long values.

methods.name: isEntityExists
methods.description: Checks if an entity exists in the database.

methods.name: createRelationFromEdge
methods.description: Creates a relation from an edge to an entity.

methods.name: pushEntityEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes an entity event message to the rule engine, with overloads for including edge context.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerId from an entity if available.

methods.name: getEdgeActionTbMsgMetaData
methods.description: Creates message metadata for edge actions.

methods.name: isSaveRequired
methods.description: Determines if an entity needs to be saved based on version comparison.

methods.name: generateUniqueNameIfDuplicateExists
methods.description: Generates a unique name if a duplicate entity name exists.

methods.name: generateRandomAlphabeticString
methods.description: Generates a random alphabetic string appended to a prefix.
